ck_adonai_seed_father_secret_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = character:777125
			exists = character:777777
			character:777125 = {
				is_alive = yes
				NOT = { exists = father }
			}
			character:777777 = {
				is_alive = yes
				NOT = { any_secret = { secret_type = ck_secret_adonai_father } }
			}
		}
		character:777777 = {
			add_secret = {
				type = ck_secret_adonai_father
				target = character:777125
			}
		}
	}
}

ck_adonai_seed_mother_secret_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = character:777125

			}

				is_alive = yes
				NOT = { any_secret = { secret_type = ck_secret_adonai_mother } }
			}
		}
		character:777124 = {
			add_secret = {
				type = ck_secret_adonai_mother
				target = character:777125
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope: the child. First parent made public: Disputed Heritage. Second: both parents known and never wed, so Bastard instead.
ck_adonai_parentage_exposed_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_character_flag = ck_parentage_once_exposed }
		remove_trait = disputed_heritage
		add_trait = bastard
	}
	else = {
		add_trait = disputed_heritage
		add_character_flag = ck_parentage_once_exposed
	}
	add_piety = major_piety_loss
	faith = {
		change_fervor = {
			value = -10
			desc = ck_fervor_loss_lord_has_parents
		}
	}
}
